label: Cardiovascular Risk Indicators
description: Elevated lipid levels are associated with cardiovascular health. Discuss these findings with your doctor.

label: Lipid Imbalance Detected
description: Low HDL combined with high LDL may reflect an unfavorable lipid profile. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Long-Term Glucose Control Indicators
description: Elevated blood glucose and HbA1c together suggest the body may be having difficulty managing blood sugar over time. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Pre-Diabetes Pattern Indicators
description: HbA1c in the borderline range combined with elevated fasting blood sugar may indicate a pattern worth discussing with your doctor.

label: Thyroid Function Indicators
description: Abnormal TSH or thyroid hormone levels may indicate thyroid function changes. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Anemia Pattern Indicators
description: Low hemoglobin combined with low RBC or iron levels may suggest anemia. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Iron Store Indicators
description: Low iron and ferritin may indicate depleted iron stores. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Kidney Function Indicators
description: Elevated creatinine or uric acid may indicate changes in kidney function. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Liver Enzyme Indicators
description: Elevated liver enzymes may indicate liver stress or damage. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Vitamin Deficiency Indicators
description: Low vitamin levels can affect energy, immunity, and bone health. Discuss supplementation with your doctor.

label: Electrolyte Imbalance Indicators
description: Abnormal sodium or potassium levels can affect heart and nerve function. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Inflammation Indicators
description: Elevated CRP is a general marker of inflammation in the body. Discuss with your doctor to identify potential causes.

label: Microcytic Anemia Pattern Indicators
description: Low MCV combined with low MCH and low iron stores may suggest microcytic anemia. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Infection / Inflammation Indicators
description: Elevated WBC, neutrophils, or ESR may suggest an active infection or inflammatory process. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Renal Stress Indicators
description: Elevated BUN and creatinine together with low eGFR may indicate kidney function changes. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Extended Liver Stress Indicators
description: Elevated GGT combined with elevated liver enzymes and bilirubin may indicate liver stress. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Iron Overload Indicators
description: Elevated iron, ferritin, and transferrin saturation may indicate iron overload. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Dehydration Pattern Indicators
description: Elevated hematocrit, sodium, and BUN may suggest dehydration. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Eosinophilia Indicators
description: Elevated eosinophil count may indicate allergic reactions, parasitic infections, or other conditions. Discuss with your doctor.

label: Urinary Tract Indicators
description: Elevated pus cells or RBC in urine may indicate a urinary tract infection or other urinary conditions. Discuss with your doctor.
